text:
[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
match operations with
| []       => false
| (x::xs)  => (xs.any (fun y => (x + y < 0))) || implementation xs
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma implementation_loop_threshold_invariant
(operations: List Int)
(k: Int)
(h_operations_length: operations.length > 0)
: implementation (operations.map (fun x => x + k)) = implementation operations
:= by
simp [implementation]
induction' operations generalizing k
simp at h_operations_length
rename_i head tail ih
have h_tail_length := List.length.tail (operations.length > 0)
simp at h_tail_length
have h_tail_non_empty := Nat.succ_pos h_tail_length
have h_tail_length_pos := Nat.zero_le h_tail_length
by_cases h_head_ge_zero: head + k ≥ 0
-- case where head + k ≥ 0
simp [h_head_ge_zero]
simp [h_head_ge_zero] at ih
have h_head_ge_zero': 0 ≤ head + k := by
  linarith
rw [Int.zero_le_add] at h_head_ge_zero'
simp [h_head_ge_zero']
-- case where tail.length ≤ 0
have h_tail_length_le_0 := Nat.zero_le h_tail_length
simp [h_tail_length_le_0]
simp [h_tail_length_le_0] at ih
have h_tail_empty := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero h_tail_length_le_0
simp [h_tail_empty]
-- case where tail.length > 0
have h_tail_length_gt_0 := Nat.succ_pos h_tail_length
simp [h_tail_length_gt_0] at ih
specialize ih (head + k)
simp [←ih]
-- case where head + k < 0
have h_head_lt_zero: ¬ (0 ≤ head + k) := by
  linarith
rw [Int.zero_le_add] at h_head_lt_zero
simp [h_head_lt_zero]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation operations
use result
simp [result]
intros h_operations_length
have h_stop := implementation_loop_threshold_invariant operations 0 h_operations_length
by_cases h_implementation_stop: implementation operations = false
-- Case 1: where implementation operations = false
simp [h_implementation_stop]
simp [h_implementation_stop] at h_stop
exact h_stop
-- Case 2: where implementation operations ≠ false
simp [h_implementation_stop]
have h_implementation_stop': true = implementation operations := by
  by_contra
  rename_i h_implementation_stop_false
  simp at h_implementation_stop_false
  contradiction
have h_continue := implementation_loop_invariant_continue operations 0 0 h_operations_length h_implementation_stop'
simp at h_continue
obtain ⟨i₁⟩ := h_continue
rename_i h_continue_i₁
use i₁
intro h_1_le_i₁ h_i₁_ops_len h_i₁_sum_lt_zero
simp [h_1_le_i₁, h_i₁_ops_len, h_i₁_sum_lt_zero] at h_continue_i₁
by_cases h_drop_i₁: (List.drop i₁ operations).length > 0
have h_sum_i₁ := List.sum_range' 0 i₁ 1
simp [h_sum_i₁]
simp [h_sum_i₁] at h_continue_i₁
intro h_drop_impl
simp [h_drop_impl] at h_continue_i₁
intro i''
intro h_i''_le_i₁
have h'' := h_continue_i₁ i''
by_cases h_1_le_i'': 1 ≤ i''
simp [h_1_le_i''] at h''
assumption
simp at h_1_le_i''
linarith
simp at h_drop_i₁
have h_i₁_eq_operations_len : i₁ = operations.length := by
  linarith
simp [h_i₁_eq_operations_len] at h_continue_i₁
simp [implementation] at h_continue_i₁
simp [h_i₁_eq_operations_len]
simp [implementation]
exact h_continue_i₁
[END]
